$comment: Source file_format_specifications: https://data.igvf.org/documents/e204bbb2-3249-499f-bfc8-0e0ab38cc3a4/ The standard also allows enhancer and other element types with optional gene IDs. This catalog genes_genes schema and current adapter support gene-associated promoters only. Coordinates and element types are represented through linked genomic_elements; endpoint ordering is catalog-defined.

_key.description: Correlation file accession, upstream regulator file accession, canonical gene pair, and correlation suffix.

_from.description: Catalog gene for a perturbed regulator, derived from gene_1 or gene_2 (IGVF GENCODE v43 Ensembl ID). Required for promoter-targeting regulators; this genes_genes schema represents that subset of the standard. Endpoints are canonically ordered.

_to.description: Catalog gene for a perturbed regulator, derived from gene_1 or gene_2 (IGVF GENCODE v43 Ensembl ID). Required for promoter-targeting regulators; this genes_genes schema represents that subset of the standard. Endpoints are canonically ordered.

pearson_correlation.title: Pearson Correlation
pearson_correlation.description: Pearson correlation of the two perturbed regulators' log2FC measurements over gene programs. N/A, NaN, and blank source values are represented as null.

genomic_elements_from.title: Genomic Elements From
genomic_elements_from.description: Catalog elements for the _from regulator, derived from the corresponding genomic_element_coordinates_1 or genomic_element_coordinates_2 hg38 coordinates. Comma-separated source intervals become separate references, retaining their upstream regulator identity.

genomic_elements_to.title: Genomic Elements To
genomic_elements_to.description: Catalog elements for the _to regulator, derived from the corresponding genomic_element_coordinates_1 or genomic_element_coordinates_2 hg38 coordinates. Comma-separated source intervals become separate references, retaining their upstream regulator identity.
